units.en: New Qing commissioner Huo Yanwei reported executing Deng prefect Wang Gongyan and eight plotters, including Li Jin and Wang Juhou.
units.literal: The newly appointed Qingzhou military commissioner Huo Yanwei reported that he had executed the new Dengzhou prefect Wang Gongyan and eight others who had plotted rebellion, including commanders Li Jin and Wang Juhou.

units.zh: 公儼素受希望獎愛，謂希望曰：「內侍宜分腹心之兵，監四面守陴者，則誰敢異圖。」
units.en: Gongyan, favored by Yang Xiwang, said to him, "Your Grace should divide your trusted troops to watch all four sides of the ramparts—then who would dare plot differently."
units.literal: Gongyan had long been favored by Xiwang and said to him, "Your Grace should divide your trusted troops to watch all four sides of the ramparts—then who would dare plot differently."

units.zh: 公儼乘其無備，圍希望之第，擒而殺之。
units.en: Gongyan surprised him, surrounded his house, seized Yang Xiwang, and killed him.
units.literal: Gongyan took him unawares, surrounded Xiwang's residence, seized him, and killed him.

units.zh: 公儼遂與州將李謹等謀據州城，以邀符節，即令軍府飛章留己，兼揚言符習在鎮，人不便其政，帝乃除公儼為登州刺史。
units.en: Gongyan and Li Jin seized the city, memorialized to keep the post, and claimed Fu Xi's rule was unpopular; Zhuangzong named him Deng prefect.
units.literal: Gongyan then with prefectural officers Li Jin and others plotted to hold the prefectural city to demand the commission, had the military government send a flying memorial to keep himself in post, and also spread word that while Fu Xi was in the prefecture the people found his rule hard; the Emperor then appointed Gongyan Dengzhou prefect.

units.zh: 初，同光中，符習為青州節度使，宦官楊希望為監軍，專製軍政。
units.en: In Tongguang Fu Xi had held Qing while eunuch Yang Xiwang as monitor controlled the army.
units.literal: Earlier, in the Tongguang era Fu Xi was Qingzhou military commissioner and eunuch Yang Xiwang was army monitor, monopolizing military government.

units.zh: 彥威懲其初心，遣人擒公儼於北海縣，與同黨斬於州東。
units.en: Yanwei seized Gongyan at Beihai and beheaded him and his party east of the city.
units.literal: Yanwei, punishing his original intent, sent men to seize Gongyan at Beihai County and with his accomplices beheaded him east of the prefecture.

units.zh: 〈（《通鑒》：彥威聚兵淄州，以圖進取，公儼懼。
units.en: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》 says Yanwei concentrated at Zi to advance and Gongyan panicked.
units.literal: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》: Yanwei massed troops at Zi Prefecture intending to advance; Gongyan was afraid.

units.zh: 乙未，始之官。
units.en: On yiwei he finally reported to his post.
units.literal: On yiwei he finally took office.

units.zh: 丁酉，彥威至青州，追擒之。）〉
units.en: On dingyou Yanwei reached Qingzhou and arrested him.)〉
units.literal: On dingyou Yanwei reached Qing and pursued and captured him.)〉

units.zh: 以禮部尚書、興唐尹王正言依前禮部尚書，充租庸使。
units.en: Wang Zhengyan stayed Minister of Rites and was made land-tax commissioner.
units.literal: Minister of Rites and Xingtang prefect Wang Zhengyan remained Minister of Rites and was made commissioner of land tax and corvée.

units.zh: 其宋光嗣相見之時，於坐上便有言說，先問契丹強弱，次數秦王是非，度此包藏，可見情狀。
units.en: Song Guangsi at table asked first about Khitan strength, then judged the Prince of Qin—showing his hidden intent.
units.literal: When Song Guangsi met him, at table he spoke at once, first asking whether the Khitan were strong or weak, then counting right and wrong for the Prince of Qin—judging this hidden intent, his disposition could be seen.

units.zh: 今觀孽豎，紹據山河，委閹宦以持權，憑阻修而僭號。
units.en: Now a wicked youth holds Shu, gives eunuchs power, and leans on mountains to play emperor.
units.literal: Now this wicked stripling has succeeded to mountains and rivers, entrusts power to eunuch officials, and relies on rugged passes to usurp title.

units.zh: 九月辛卯朔，河陽奏，黃河漲一丈五尺。
units.en: On the xinmao new moon of the ninth month Heyang said the Yellow River was up 1.5 zhang.
units.literal: Ninth month, xinmao new moon: Heyang reported the Yellow River had risen one zhang five chi.

units.zh: 然自此權臣愎戾，伶官用事，吏人孔謙酷加賦斂，赦文之所原放，謙復刻剝不行，大失人心，始於此矣。
units.en: Yet from then on ministers turned stubborn, actors held power, and Kong Qian re-levied what the amnesty had freed—hearts were lost from this day.
units.literal: Yet from this time powerful ministers grew obstinate, actor-officials held office, and clerk Kong Qian harshly added levies; what the amnesty had remitted Qian again exacted and would not carry out—greatly losing hearts, it began here.

units.zh: 庚午，租庸使孔謙奏：「諸道綱運客旅，多於私路苟免商稅，請令所在關防嚴加捉搦。」
units.en: On gengwu Kong Qian memorialized, "Transport convoys and traveling merchants on the circuits often evade commercial tax on private routes; order every pass and barrier to seize them strictly."
units.literal: On gengwu land-tax commissioner Kong Qian memorialized: "Transport convoys and traveling merchants on the circuits often evade commercial tax on private routes; order every pass and barrier to seize them strictly."

units.zh: 帝令史建瑭以輕騎嘗寇，獲芻牧者二百人，問其兵數，精兵七萬。
units.en: He sent Shi Jiantang with light horse to scout, took two hundred foragers, and learned that the enemy elite alone numbered seventy thousand.
units.literal: The Emperor ordered Shi Jiantang with light cavalry to probe the enemy; he seized two hundred foragers and asked their strength—they said the elite numbered seventy thousand.

units.zh: 詰旦，進軍，距柏鄉一舍，周德威、史建瑭率蕃落勁騎以挑戰，四面馳射，梁軍閉壁不出，乃退。
units.en: At dawn he moved up to within one march of Baixiang; Dewei and Jiantang led tough frontier horse in circling challenges and volleys until the Liang men shut their walls and would not fight, then drew off.
units.literal: At dawn he advanced, halting one stage from Baixiang; Zhou Dewei and Shi Jiantang led fierce frontier cavalry to challenge, riding about on four sides shooting; the Liang army shut their walls and would not come out, and they withdrew.

units.zh: 十二月丁巳朔，梁祖聞帝軍屯趙州，命寧國軍節度使王景仁為北面行營招討使，韓為副，相州刺史李思安為前鋒，會魏州之兵以討王鎔；
units.en: On dingsi, the first day of the twelfth month, learning that the Jin host lay at Zhao, the Liang Founder made Wang Jingren of Ningguo overall northern commander, with Han as his deputy and Li Si'an of Xiang as vanguard, to unite Wei forces against Wang Rong;
units.literal: Twelfth month, first day dingsi, the Liang Founder heard that the Emperor's army was encamped at Zhao and appointed Ningguo Army military commissioner Wang Jingren overall northern campaign commander, with Han as deputy and Xiangzhou prefect Li Si'an as vanguard, to join Wei troops and attack Wang Rong;

units.zh: 光業以書呈樞密承旨李虔徽。
units.en: Guangye presented the letter to Secretariat drafter Li Qianhui.
units.literal: Guangye presented the letter to Secretariat drafter Li Qianhui.

units.zh: 會朝廷再發中使荀鹹乂將兵赴閬州，光業謂虔徽曰：「鹹乂未至，吾父必反。
units.en: When the court again sent the inner envoy Gou Xianyi with troops to Langzhou, Guangye told Qianhui: "Before Xianyi arrives my father will rebel.
units.literal: When the court again sent inner envoy Gou Xianyi with troops to Lang Prefecture, Guangye told Qianhui: "Before Xianyi arrives my father will rebel.

units.zh: 制以郢王友圭充控鶴指揮使，諸軍都虞候閻寶為御營使。
units.en: Prince of Ying Yougui was made Crane-Control commander and Yan Bao, army chief of staff, imperial camp commissioner.
units.literal: An edict made Prince of Ying Yougui Crane-Control commander and army chief of staff Yan Bao imperial camp commissioner.

units.zh: 以鄴都副留守、興唐尹張憲檢校吏部尚書、太原尹，充北京副留守、知留守事。
units.en: Zhang Xian—Yedu deputy regent and Xingtang prefect—became acting Personnel minister, Taiyuan prefect, and northern deputy regent in charge of regency.
units.literal: Yedu deputy regent and Xingtang prefect Zhang Xian was made acting Minister of Personnel, Taiyuan prefect, and northern capital deputy regent with charge of regency affairs.

units.zh: 陝州節度使張延朗移鎮許州，加檢校太傅；
units.en: Zhang Yanlang of Shaan moved to Xu with inspector grand mentor rank;
units.literal: Shaan prefecture military commissioner Zhang Yanlang was transferred to Xu prefecture and given added Inspector Grand Mentor;

units.zh: 廷贇乃璋之假侄，稱有叔在蜀，欲往省之，亦無私書，詔停任，令歸私第。
units.en: Tingyun was Zhang's adoptive nephew. He said he had an uncle in Shu whom he wished to visit, and no secret letter was found. An edict relieved Zhang of his post and ordered him home.
units.literal: Tingyun was Zhang's adoptive nephew. He claimed to have an uncle in Shu and wished to visit him, and there was in fact no secret letter. An edict suspended Zhang's office and ordered him to return to his private residence.

units.zh: 朝廷移授昭義節度使，璋謀欲不奉詔，判官邊蔚密言規責，乃僶勉承命。
units.en: When the court reassigned him to the Zhaoyi circuit, Zhang considered defying the order. Only after his secretary Bian Wei quietly reprimanded him did he grudgingly accept.
units.literal: The court transferred him to the Zhaoyi military commissionership. Zhang planned to refuse the decree, but his aide Bian Wei privately admonished him, and he reluctantly accepted.

units.zh: 明宗嗣位，錄平蜀功，授邠州節度使。
units.en: When Emperor Mingzong took the throne, Zhang's role in the conquest of Shu was formally acknowledged, and he was given Binzhou as his circuit.
units.literal: When Emperor Mingzong succeeded to the throne, Zhang's service in pacifying Shu was recognized, and he was appointed military commissioner of Binzhou.

units.zh: 丁未，宮苑使董光業並妻子並斬於都市，璋之子也。
units.en: On dingwei palace park commissioner Dong Guangye, wife, and children were beheaded in the market—Zhang's son.
units.literal: On dingwei palace park commissioner Dong Guangye, his wife, and children were all beheaded in the market—Zhang's son.

units.zh: 己丑，以振武軍節度使、權安義留後、檢校太傅、平章事李存霸為潞州節度使，以捧日都指揮使、鄭州防禦使李紹琛為陝州節度使，以成德軍馬步軍都指揮使、右監門衛大將軍毛璋為華州節度使。
units.en: On jichou Cunba took Luzhou, Li Shaochen Shanzhou, and Mao Zhang Huazhou.
units.literal: On jichou Zhenwu military commissioner, acting Anyi regent, Grand Mentor, and chief minister Li Cunba was made Luzhou military commissioner; Sun-Rising commander and Zhengzhou defender Li Shaochen was made Shanzhou military commissioner; Chengde horse-and-foot commander and Right Gate Guard general Mao Zhang was made Huazhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 希望遣兵邀之，習懼而還。
units.en: Yang Xiwang sent troops to cut him off; Fu Xi retreated in fear.
units.literal: Xiwang sent troops to intercept him; Xi, afraid, turned back.

units.zh: 希望聞魏軍亂，遣兵圍守習家，欲盡殺之。
units.en: Hearing of the Wei mutiny, Yang Xiwang besieged Fu Xi's family to kill them all.
units.literal: Hearing the Wei army had mutinied, Xiwang sent troops to surround Xi's household intending to kill everyone.

units.zh: 其年秋，東川節度使董璋上言：「毛璋男廷贇齎父書往西川，慮有陰事。」
units.en: That autumn, Dong Zhang, military commissioner of Dongchuan, memorialized: "Mao Zhang's son Tingyun is carrying a letter from his father to western Sichuan, and I fear some covert design lies behind the journey."
units.literal: That autumn, Dongchuan military commissioner Dong Zhang memorialized: "Mao Zhang's son Tingyun, bearing a letter from his father, is going to western Sichuan; I fear there is a secret plot."

units.zh: 李紹真復曰霍彥威，李紹英復曰房知溫，李紹虔復曰王晏球，李紹奇復曰夏魯奇，李紹能復曰米君立。
units.en: Li Shaozhen became Huo Yanwei, Li Shaoying Fang Zhiwen, Li Shaogian Wang Yanqiu, Li Shaoqi Xia Luqi, Li Shaoneng Mi Junli.
units.literal: Li Shaozhen was restored as Huo Yanwei, Li Shaoying as Fang Zhiwen, Li Shaogian as Wang Yanqiu, Li Shaoqi as Xia Luqi, Li Shaoneng as Mi Junli.

units.zh: 徐州節度使李紹真、貝州刺史李紹英、齊州防禦使李紹虔、河陽節度使李紹奇、洺州刺史李紹能等上言，前朝寵賜姓名，今乞還舊。
units.en: Li Shaozhen, military commissioner of Xuzhou; Li Shaoying, prefect of Beizhou; Li Shaoqian, defense commissioner of Qizhou; Li Shaoqi, military commissioner of Heyang; Li Shaoneng, prefect of Mingzhou; and others memorialized that the previous dynasty had favored them by bestowing surnames and personal names, and they now begged to restore their old names.
units.literal: Xuzhou military commissioner Li Shaozhen, Beizhou prefect Li Shaoying, Qizhou defense commissioner Li Shaogian, Heyang military commissioner Li Shaoqi, Mingzhou prefect Li Shaoneng, and others memorialized that the former dynasty had bestowed surnames and given names and they now begged to restore the old.

units.zh: 戊午，河陽節度使夏魯奇加檢校太傅，以貝州刺史房知溫為兗州節度使，以齊州防禦使王晏球為宋州節度使，以洺州刺史米君立為邢州節度使。
units.en: On wuwu, Xia Luqi, military commissioner of Heyang, was made acting Grand Preceptor; Fang Zhiwen, prefect of Beizhou, was made military commissioner of Yanzhou; Wang Yanqiu, defense commissioner of Qizhou, was made military commissioner of Songzhou; and Mi Junli, prefect of Mingzhou, was made military commissioner of Xingzhou.
units.literal: On wuwu, Heyang military commissioner Xia Luqi was made acting Grand Preceptor; Beizhou prefect Fang Zhiwen was made Yanzhou military commissioner; Qizhou defense commissioner Wang Yanqiu was made Songzhou military commissioner; Mingzhou prefect Mi Junli was made Xingzhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 嚴之母，賢明婦人。
units.en: Yan's mother was a wise and virtuous woman.
units.literal: Yan's mother was a wise and worthy woman.

units.zh: 初，嚴將赴蜀，母曰：「汝前啟破蜀之謀，今又入蜀，將死報蜀人矣！
units.en: When Yan was about to depart for Shu, his mother said, "You first proposed the plan to destroy Shu, and now you enter Shu again. You will die repaying the people of Shu!
units.literal: At first, when Yan was about to go to Shu, his mother said: "You once opened the plan to destroy Shu; now you enter Shu again—you will die repaying the people of Shu!

units.zh: 與汝永訣。」
units.en: I bid you farewell forever."
units.literal: I take my eternal leave of you."

units.zh: 乙巳，以滄州節度使、檢校太傅、同平章事符習為青州節度使，以北京衙內馬步軍都指揮使、右領軍衛大將軍李紹斌為滄州節度使。
units.en: On yisi Fu Xi of Cangzhou—acting Grand Tutor and chancellor—went to Qing, and Li Shaobin, inner horse-and-foot commander of the northern capital and Right Guard general, took Cang.
units.literal: On yisi, Cangzhou military commissioner, acting Grand Tutor, and co-equal chief minister Fu Xi was made Qingzhou military commissioner; the northern capital's inner horse-and-foot commander and Right Imperial Guard general Li Shaobin was made Cangzhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 嚴聞之喜，即馳騎入益州，衍見嚴於母前，以母、妻為托。
units.en: Yan was delighted to hear it and rode at once into Yizhou. Wang Yan received him before his mother and entrusted his mother and wife to Yan's care.
units.literal: Yan heard this with joy and at once galloped into Yizhou; Wang Yan received Yan before his mother and entrusted his mother and wife to Yan.
